attribution_note: Requested Astra/max is not model/effort attestation. This host did not expose authenticated runtime model/effort to this reviewer.
review_scope: Local source/JSON/sha256/AST only. No SSH, neural-network execution, GPU query, active log/PID/weight/environment inspection, training or accuracy certification.

blockers.title: Later waves are admitted without actual throughput, original-task slowdown, or swap evidence
blockers.details: Phases 6/8 accept a previous FORMAL_STARTUP_PASS after one startup CSV observation. next_observation_epoch is written but never consumed or enforced. The launcher neither computes delta-update throughput nor compares the original eight jobs against a measured baseline; it checks only MemAvailable and does not examine system/process swap before expansion. The supplied historical capacity records already contain nonzero swap (43,344, 471,876 and 668,000 KiB for three original children), so this is an evidenced capacity concern. A completed four-update allocator profile is not a sustained wave-health measurement.
blockers.required_change: Before phase 6 or 8, require a sealed observation of the previous wave at its scheduled diagnostic node, with actual aggregate update rate, original-task slowdown, RAM and swap measurements and an explicit admission decision. Preserve the original eight tasks.

blockers.title: The ownership guard conflates a running native child with CUDA readiness
blockers.details: The wrapper writes RUNNING before spawning its child. A child then imports code and hashes source/input files before its first .cuda(). The next same-card launch includes every RUNNING child in expected GPU PIDs and requires actual==expected after only a fixed two-second sleep. Phase 4 starts three consecutive sanities on GPU 2 and three on GPU 3, so legitimate CPU initialization can make the next launch abort. The same transition applies to sequential same-card formal launches. Static string expansion reproduces an admissible RUNNING/no-CUDA state rejected by the guard; this is a source state-machine counterexample, not an observed runtime failure.
blockers.required_change: Represent registered-but-initializing children separately from GPU-ready owners. Require all known ready children to be present and every actual CUDA process to belong to registered children. Limit slots by registered live children, including initializing children. Do not weaken foreign-process rejection or restart any job.

blockers.title: Partial sanity launches are not durably represented in the wave state
blockers.details: The initial report is saved before launching, but each sanity PID/command remains only in memory until all eight launch calls succeed. A T2 guard failure during the second same-card sanity leaves a launched child absent from the durable cases and the report still SOURCE_ADMITTED_HOST_PROFILE_PASSED. The report then prevents re-entry with assert not report_path.exists(). Formal receipts are written per case, but the state label remains SANITIES_LAUNCHED until the entire loop completes. This does not stop the old eight, but makes the new wave lifecycle incomplete and unreviewable after a partial launch.
blockers.required_change: Persist each returned sanity/formal launch receipt immediately, with explicit partial-launch/admission/formal transition states. Preserve existing identities and do not add automatic retries, fallbacks, or duplicate launches.

source_map_scope: Exact union of the 32 training-plan maps and extended evaluation source map (57). The separately audited allocator helper is supplementary.

registration.details: Exactly 32 unique configurations = 2 objectives x K4/K8 x eight costs. 24 new plans, original eight exact hashes retained, 64 distinct run names and task names; phase counts yield 4/6/8 per card.

training_recipe.details: All 24 plans match objective-specific original K4/cost0 controls except declared configuration, identities, allocator environment, source additions and descriptive bindings. Seed2027, 882 sequence order, two rounds, stride5, LR1e-4/preview1e-5, weight decay1e-4, original B6250 and protected SOT ep14 bindings unchanged; full 182182 updates/917106 tracked frames/1764 initializes. Original trainers and all original source hashes unchanged.

source_gates.details: Native/plan/source/input checks precede NN in each trainer; sanity admission and frozen/teacher/replay/reload checks precede formal. Formal loads original candidate_b6250, never sanity weights. No source kill/preemption/retry/fallback path in the new launcher.

generated_programs.details: Expanded and AST-parsed 96 generated remote programs; checked all 48 sanity/formal argv vectors without executing project imports or remote code.

host_allocator_recipe.details: Both profile plans/source maps match their registered hashes and differ only in allocator environment and identities. Profile source compares 265 state tensors, recursive optimizer state and both CSV bytes after native0. Launcher requires equality flags and reduced sampled peak PSS before any launch; actual result remains unverified.

no_new_results.details: Registration is PLANNED/REGISTERED_SOURCE_REVIEW_PENDING. No new training, accuracy, speed, memory success, or model completion is asserted by this audit.

runtime_requirements: The actual paired allocator result was not inspected and is not certified. Before any new formal training, it must demonstrate native exit 0 for default and compact, bit-equal 265 model-state tensors and complete optimizer state, byte-equal trajectory/query-label CSVs, and strictly lower compact sampled peak PSS.
The compact allocator environment is identical across all new plans and the registered profile case; four-step equivalence does not establish full-training equivalence or formal steady-state PSS.
All local-unavailable inputs and all weight hashes must be checked by the original trainers at runtime. This audit intentionally did not read weights or remote inputs.

Each new configuration must pass its own real four-update/20-frame/one-initialize sanity, native exit 0, 251 frozen plus 14 changed tensors, strict reload, selected execution replay and preserved teacher/tracker state before formal reset to original B6250.
All native ownership, RAM/GPU capacity, throughput and slowdown claims remain runtime-gated. No formal job or evaluation is launched by this review.
